(Lebuh Raya Duta-Ulu Kelang Fasa 2 Sri Damansara Link) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Oktober 2017.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi had

laju yang dinyatakan dalan ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (DUTA-ULU KELANG EXPRESSWAY PHASE 2 SRI DAMANSARA LINK)

ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Duta-Ulu Kelang

Expressway Phase 2 Sri Damansara Link) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 October 2017.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Second Schedule.
